label: Doctor's tip · B12
head: Going Vegan?
Take your B12.
name: Dr. Neal Barnard
end_cta: Find Dr. Neal Barnard on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: A Vegan diet is always a good thing.
It is true, there are a lot of foods that are Vegan that may not be the healthiest for us,
but going Vegan just means a person decides: I'm not eating animals anymore.
That's a really good step, almost no matter how you do it.
Getting the meat and the cheese and the junk out of your diet is a good thing,
There's one supplement that you really ought to take: vitamin B12.
You need it for healthy nerves, healthy blood,
and it's in every multiple vitamin you ever took.
